name: Aetherspike
description: You target a creature within moderate (20 unit) range and drive a spike of chaotic energy through them, dealing 8 aetheric damage. For every other creature within a very short (5 unit) radius of the target, the damage increases based on their tier: minions and grunts add 1, standard creatures add 2, champion and higher add 3. If you do not roll at least 2 successes, the spike targets a random creature within range instead.
charge: The radius for counting additional creatures increases to short (10 units).
